qa_pair.question: Discover the Word export tool that offers page-image appearance, then inspect it. Which native output extension does it create?
Find searchable scanned-PDF conversion, inspect its limits and read the policy. Which recognition language is supported?
Discover hidden-data cleanup tools and try a workflow with the one marked unavailable. What is the stable ID of the rejected sanitization tool?
Discover the extractive summary tool and the browser AI summarizer. Inspect both statuses. Which ID depends on browser AI APIs?
Discover text comparison and visual comparison, then inspect their limitations. Which ID displays corresponding pages side by side?
Find both PDF compression workflows and inspect their limits. Which ID optimizes structure without rasterizing text?
Discover PDF protection and unlocking, then read the policy resource. Does the MCP accept a document password to perform unlocking?
Find PDF-to-PowerPoint conversion and inspect its output limits. Is original page text editable as individual slide objects?
Find the PDF-to-PNG tools, inspect them and plan the all-pages export. Which ID produces a ZIP of all page images?
Discover merge and lossless compression, then plan them in that order. What is the plan's executesDocuments field?
